$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/insights.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). Office only: apps/factory-api modules/insights writes them through command(), for the person acting on a row of Today (the API asks actingPermission first: the record's view and act permissions over its company, site and party), and keeps each person to their own layout. Floor and portal/link sessions read and write nothing here. AttentionAction is changed (assigned, resolved, acknowledged), never deleted; AttentionActionLog is append-only (`@append-only`; the …_insights_attention_actions_guards triggers refuse UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE for every login); a TodayLayout is saved again, never deleted. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

AttentionAction.about: What people did about a row of Today: the office records an assignment, a resolution with its note and an acknowledgement (each with the row's condition) and reads them to show Today.

AttentionActionLog.about: The history of Today's actions: the office adds one row per thing done and reads a person's own rows ('Handled today'). Never changed or removed.

TodayLayout.about: One person's arrangement of Today: the office saves and reads the signed-in person's own.

ReportRun.about: W2b (B-W2b-03): the office adds one row when a person runs a report and reads the person's own rows ('last run by me'); never another person's (the API keeps each person to their own). Never changed (no update grant; the …_followups_platform_w2b_guards trigger refuses UPDATE for every login); deleted only by a retention rule (the privacy step's; none yet).
